sampling: risk-weighted: 51 assertions across CCG (21), WTC (13), DD (8), RSPEC (9). Items chosen where a wrong value changes pay, tax or a filing: rates, ceilings, thresholds, dates of effect, base rules (PMSS/PASS, SMIC live vs frozen, RGDU parameters, Agirc-Arrco/CEG/CET/Apec, unemployment/AGS 4 PSS, CSG/CRDS 98.25 % to 4 PASS, COTAM 5.50 %, CPF-CDD 1 %, PAS default grids by payment date, CGI 182 A bands, montant net social 2026, net taxable with employer health cover, AT/MP daily benefit), DSN rubric formats and control rules (S21.G00.82.005, 56.002, 58.003, 81.001/004/007), payroll tax and apprenticeship tax bands, DPAE format 120. Risk areas informed by the 2026-10-06 reviews; verdicts not reused - every source fetched on 2026-10-09 and quoted. Artifact excerpts were machine-checked to be verbatim; quotes machine-checked against the fetched text (except the Légifrance KALI quote, read through WebFetch). DSN cahier quotes carry the PDF page in source.page.
